Nora CSM: Heads-up — Acme onboarding QBR next Wed. Need a compact spend & burn profile + one-slide recommendation for chargeback or credit buffer. Can we get numbers and risk flags by EOD tomorrow?
Sam (FinOps): On it. I ran a quick forecast — curious if we should include a worst-case activation spike scenario. :thinking_face:
Alex Eng: FYI we've seen a 35% increase in embed-heavy calls from their staging tenant the last 7 days. Might bump tokens.
Sam (FinOps): Good catch. Baseline forecast: 1.8M tokens/mo. With current growth trend + activation it becomes ~2.7M/mo. Worst-case (campaign) ~4.1M/mo.
Maria Enablement: For the QBR slide, buyers want a clear recommendation: guardrail + playbook or immediate short-term top-up? I can draft the enablement bullets if you give the numbers.
Nora CSM: Prefer guardrail + one-time top-up proposal. Also capture renewal risk — they said budget cap in contract. If we hit >3M/mo we flag finance.
Sam (FinOps): I'll prepare three scenarios and an ask: 1) auto-burst with soft cap 2) prepaid credit for next 90 days 3) chargeback model with per-team allocation.
Alex Eng: Raw query I ran if anyone wants to reproduce:
```sql
-- tokens by tenant last 30d
SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_30d
FROM usage.events
WHERE tenant_id = 'acme-corp' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```
Sam (FinOps): Attaching quick numbers here: baseline 1.8M, expected (trend) 2.7M, alert threshold we propose 3.0M, emergency cap 4.5M. Recommend sending a pre-QBR email with alerts on at 2.8M and 3.5M.
billing-bot: [alert] acme-corp usage crossed 1.25M tokens in the last 7 days — billing thresholds approaching.
Nora CSM: Thanks — Maria can you draft the slide + short email copy? Sam will QA numbers; Alex please confirm nothing else inflates billing (eg test scripts).
Maria Enablement: Yep — will draft slide + two email options (technical + exec). ETA EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Alex Eng: I'll scan test fleets and confirm by EOD.
Sam (FinOps): I'll put the scenario table and suggested guardrail config into a short doc and paste numbers in thread when ready.
Nora CSM: Great — this will be the basis for the QBR talking points and the recommended chargeback path. If we have time, include a one-line cost-savings by enabling prefix caching (est. 12% token reduction).
Maria Enablement: Noted. Will add caching note + quick enablement checklist.
Nora CSM: Thanks team. If anyone sees surprise spend overnight ping here. :eyes:
